sections.body:
LLM chat and assistants; writing and paraphrasing; image generation; voice / text-to-speech. Basic · free · LLM chat and assistants | Starter | Creator. Synthesia is an AI avatar-presenter video studio for training, enablement, and on-brand explainers. Credits are the shared currency: Basic is free with 1,200 credits/month (~10 min. That catalogue mix is the Synthesia setup filter — not a generic ai lecture.

Buyer question: does Starter gating enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Starter, Creator, Enterprise) change the Synthesia decision before seats scale?

Decision thesis: unlike a generic ai shortlist, Synthesia is worth it if L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers outweighs Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo — trade-off accepted before seats scale.

Best for: L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers; Internal comms that need on-brand avatars without a film crew; Creator/Enterprise buyers who need API, SSO, or SCORM (L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers).

Poor fit when: Generative B-roll / text-to-shot filmmaking (Runway); Still-image art direction (Midjourney); Buyers who need a free plan that actually exports MP4. Avoid if Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo would block go-live.

sections.heading: Synthesia limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo; Credits buy minutes of avatar video — not unlimited renders; Not a generative-filmmaking studio like Runway Gen-4 because it forces process changes or add-ons around Synthesia when LLM chat and assistants is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Basic until enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Starter, Creator, Enterprise) is mandatory; plan jumps to Starter only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Starter, Creator, Enterprise) at the expense of Published free tiers vs paid usage/credit caps — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Basic · free · LLM chat and assistants | Starter | Creator.

Alternative context: unlike Runway, Synthesia is preferable when L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers because LLM chat and assistants plus enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Starter, Creator, Enterprise) match; prefer Runway when Generative B-roll / text-to-shot filmmaking (Runway) because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Synthesia
sections.body:
Scenario: for LLM chat and assistants teams, recommend Synthesia when L&D and enablement teams producing talking-head explainers; recommend an alternative path when Generative B-roll / text-to-shot filmmaking (Runway) because Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for LLM chat and assistants plus a freeze window if API access are in the cutover path.

Final call: proceed with Synthesia when LLM chat and assistants plus LLM chat and assistants outweigh Basic cannot publish — no MP4 download and a persistent logo; walk when Generative B-roll / text-to-shot filmmaking (Runway) because workarounds will eat the Starter spend.
